I regressed the log of hourly wage (`wage / hours`) on `educ`, using only those three columns. The `educ` coefficient is 0.0529. Read directly, that is about a 5.29% increase in hourly wage per additional year of education. Converting it exactly with exp(0.0529) − 1 gives about 5.44%.

I'm reporting the 5.29% reading, since that is the usual interpretation of a log-linear coefficient.

ANSWER: 5.29%
